identity_and_intrinsics: Run original official face_tracker.py on 6000 training frames only; freeze its BFM identity and focal for val/test; fit heldout expression and pose with the same official landmark objective and 2000-iteration schedule.
flow_mask: Derive three identical uint8 alpha channels as 255 minus G from official parsing/N_face.png. The portrait RGB visualization itself is not a flow mask. Original stage1 face_mask visualization copies are deprecated and never used by flow.
flow_storage: Original NeuralNRT/RAFT weights, crop processing and 12 iterations. Store only the reference rigid pixels from the first min(2500,N) frames; execute the verbatim original Laplacian/keypoint selection block; retain exact selected keypoint tracks for all frames, not all dense flow files. Dense/streamed subset parity must pass.
bundle_training: Original official bundle_adjustment.py, 500 point fitting plus 8000 joint point/pose iterations.
bundle_heldout: First 500 official point fitting iterations at training-calibrated frozen-identity BFM poses. Freeze these points, then refine only per-frame poses for 8000 iterations with the official flow reprojection loss. This deliberate heldout conditioning adaptation prevents arbitrary point/camera gauge drift; it is not default independent identity refitting.
coordinate_mapping: Estimate one positive similarity X_bundle=s Q X_BFM+T from training BFM and refined training camera pairs only. Map heldout frozen-identity refined camera poses into this training gauge. No heldout data fits Q/T/s, identity, focal, training background or generator state.
background: Original background extraction sees training frames only. Share this training background for supervision construction; heldout original images may supply their own portrait composite and torso/eye/pose conditioning, never training fitted state.
loading: Official --preload 0 is allowed to avoid >44GB float32 preload on a 31GiB host, after exact pixel/ray-input parity against preload 1 on a common subset. Rays, precision, losses, initialization, frame order, epochs and successful-update budget are unchanged. No ray reduction fallback.
decision_time: Frozen before any identity/focal/flow/bundle fitting or generator training in this new experiment. Refinement quality gates are data quality checks, never based on SyncNet ranking.
